techStack: React 19, TypeScript 5.7, Vite 6 — ESM, bundler moduleResolution
Vitest 3 with jsdom 26 and @testing-library/react 16 for integration-style tests
Tests live in /tests/ (not colocated); run via `npm run test` or `pnpm test`
ESLint flat config with eslint-plugin-react-hooks — hooks rules enforced at lint time
TypeScript strict-ish: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters — unused imports are errors
Array.prototype.sort is stable (ES2019+, es2023 target) — no secondary comparator needed
features: useFilteredProducts.ts: reads products from ProductContext and {debouncedSearch, category, inStockOnly, sortBy} from FilterContext; derives filteredProducts + resultCount via useMemo — all three bugs are in this useMemo body

productFilters.ts exports filterProducts(products, filters): filters first (search, category, inStockOnly) then sorts with [...result].sort(...) — correct pipeline, non-mutating, handles all three SortOption values and 'default'
ProductListPage.tsx (line 61) is the sole consumer of useFilteredProducts — destructures filteredProducts and resultCount
useProductFilters.ts is a legacy hook with its own fetch + local state; not consumed by any component — untouched
derivedStateCorrectness.test.tsx: 4 tests, each sets category then changes sortBy in a separate act() to isolate Bug 3; tests price-asc, price-desc, rating-desc, and no-filter price-asc variants
architecture: Layer order: API → Contexts (own state) → Hooks (derived state) → Pages (orchestrate) → Components (presentational)
Hooks call context hooks and delegate computation to pure utils in src/utils/ — this is the established convention
All three bug fixes belong inside the useMemo body in src/hooks/useFilteredProducts.ts — no other file needs changing
Optionally delegate to filterProducts from productFilters.ts (already correct) instead of fixing inline logic — both are valid; delegation is idiomatic for this codebase
Utils (src/utils/) have zero React imports — pure TypeScript functions only
edgeCases: sortBy === 'default': filter pipeline still runs; sort step is skipped; filtered result returned in insertion order — filterProducts handles this already

Mutation after partial fix: fixing Bug 3 (dep array) without Bug 2 (mutation) causes products.sort() to corrupt the context array on every sortBy-triggered recompute — both bugs must be fixed in the same change
Empty filter result: [...[]] .sort() returns a new empty array safely — no crash, no mutation

Transitioning back to 'default' after an active sort: without the mutation fix, prior sort reorders the context array permanently; after the fix, each recompute works from the original insertion-order array
Whitespace-only debouncedSearch (e.g. '   '): trimmed to '' before matching — filter is a no-op; handled by filterProducts
Multiple successive sort changes: each useMemo call spreads a fresh copy of the filtered slice — no cross-recompute mutation
Products context reference refresh (re-fetch): products is in the dep array already; recompute is triggered correctly once mutation is eliminated
Stable sort ties: JS sort is stable in ES2019+; no secondary comparator is needed or should be introduced
